description: This file defines the 'Datasource' class which models the <datasource> element in an entity configuration XML, including its attributes and child elements, used for configuring database data sources in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Datasource
classes.description: Represents a data source configuration with attributes like name, helper class, schema, connection settings, and child elements such as SQL load paths and JDBC configurations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data source.

methods.name: getHelperClass
methods.description: Returns the helper class used for the data source.

methods.name: getFieldTypeName
methods.description: Returns the field type name for the data source.

methods.name: getUseSchemas
methods.description: Indicates whether schemas are used.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Returns the schema name.

methods.name: getCheckOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether to check the data source on startup.

methods.name: getAddMissingOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether to add missing data on startup.

methods.name: getUsePkConstraintNames
methods.description: Indicates whether to use primary key constraint names.

methods.name: getCheckPksOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether to check primary keys on startup.

methods.name: getConstraintNameClipLength
methods.description: Returns the length to which constraint names are clipped.

methods.name: getUseProxyCursor
methods.description: Indicates whether to use a proxy cursor.

methods.name: getProxyCursorName
methods.description: Returns the proxy cursor name.

methods.name: getResultFetchSize
methods.description: Returns the fetch size for query results.

methods.name: getUseForeignKeys
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign keys are used.

methods.name: getUseForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign key indices are used.

methods.name: getCheckFksOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether to check foreign keys on startup.

methods.name: getCheckFkIndicesOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether to check foreign key indices on startup.

methods.name: getFkStyle
methods.description: Returns the foreign key style.

methods.name: getUseFkInitiallyDeferred
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign keys are initially deferred.

methods.name: getUseIndices
methods.description: Indicates whether indices are used.

methods.name: getUseIndicesUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether unique indices are used.

methods.name: getCheckIndicesOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether to check indices on startup.

methods.name: getJoinStyle
methods.description: Returns the join style.

methods.name: getAliasViewColumns
methods.description: Indicates whether view columns are aliased.

methods.name: getAlwaysUseConstraintKeyword
methods.description: Indicates whether to always use constraint keywords.

methods.name: getDropFkUseForeignKeyKeyword
methods.description: Indicates whether to drop foreign key constraints using keywords.

methods.name: getUseBinaryTypeForBlob
methods.description: Indicates whether to use binary type for BLOBs.

methods.name: getUseOrderByNulls
methods.description: Indicates whether to use NULLs in ORDER BY.

methods.name: getOffsetStyle
methods.description: Returns the offset style.

methods.name: getTableType
methods.description: Returns the table type.

methods.name: getCharacterSet
methods.description: Returns the character set.

methods.name: getCollate
methods.description: Returns the collation setting.

methods.name: getMaxWorkerPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum worker pool size.

methods.name: getSqlLoadPathList
methods.description: Returns the list of SQL load paths.

methods.name: getReadDataList
methods.description: Returns the list of read data configurations.

methods.name: getInlineJdbc
methods.description: Returns the inline JDBC configuration.

methods.name: getJndiJdbc
methods.description: Returns the JNDI JDBC configuration.

methods.name: getTyrexDataSource
methods.description: Returns the Tyrex data source configuration.
